bibliographic.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Healthcare LLMs with Granular Fact-Checking and Domain-Specific Adaptation

relevance_to_mlgg: Independent fact-checking module that operates without LLM dependency, validated on MIMIC-III. Fact-checking F1=0.8556. Architecture pattern for post-extraction validation in MLGG.
key_methods: Numerical test patterns for EHR validation
key_findings: Independent fact-checker more reliable than LLM self-verification
Numerical + logic patterns effective for structured medical data
actionable_for_mlgg: Build independent fact-checker for numeric extraction (AUROC, sample sizes) against paper text
Numerical pattern matching: verify extracted numbers appear in source text
Decouple verification from extraction LLM (avoid self-verification bias)
